goal: WorkGraphBuilder.build() aggregates list_work() across one or more WorkSources into a single validated WorkGraph: a cross-source prerequisite resolves as a real edge, a reference unresolved in every source surfaces as a GraphValidationIssue without raising, and structural corruption still raises WorkGraphValidationError.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00047-workgraph-validation.md -- the acceptance criteria SC-12, SC-13 this task satisfies, and the D-1 missing-prereq decision

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_sources.py -- WorkSource Protocol (list_work() is SYNC), DirectoryWorkSource, WorkItem; build() aggregates list_work() across the given sources
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_work_graph.py -- the held-out oracle for this task; make it green, do not edit it
references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_github.py -- GithubWorkSource is the second concrete WorkSource; build() must be source-kind agnostic (depend only on the list_work() protocol)
constraints: Add WorkGraphBuilder.build() taking one or more WorkSources; it calls list_work() on each, aggregates all WorkItems, then constructs and validates the graph through the workgraph-model value (reuse it, do not reimplement validation).

Validation happens AFTER full aggregation: a prerequisite satisfied by an item from a DIFFERENT source resolves as a real edge (no issue), and only a reference unresolved in EVERY source becomes a GraphValidationIssue (D-1).
Structural corruption (duplicate id across the combined item set, self-dep, cycle) raises WorkGraphValidationError exactly as the model task defines, after aggregation.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not add any field to WorkItem and do not touch core flywheel_core.task.Task.
Do not change WorkSource.list_work() to async or alter its signature.
Do not wire the builder into the orchestrate scheduling loop here -- that is the workgraph-scheduler-integration task.
Do not modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions in the held-out oracle or in test_source_registry.py.
edge_cases: A single DirectoryWorkSource (the common case) must build a graph identical in edges/issues to constructing the model directly from its WorkItems.
Two sources where source A's task depends on source B's task: the edge resolves and no issue names that pair.
A duplicate id where the two colliding items come from DIFFERENT sources must still raise (the collision is in the combined set).
